notes: 웃기다 is the causative form of 웃다 (to laugh). It is used both to describe something that is funny and to describe the action of causing someone to laugh.
Be careful with its use as an exclamation: saying '웃기네!' to someone can sound sarcastic or dismissive, as if you don't believe them.
